name: Lian'ai Qitan ~Bu Cunzai de Zhenxiang~
original_name: 恋爱绮谭~不存在的真相~
source:
Leed unexpectedly becomes the center of the storm. He must find the truth through chaos and lies.
As autumn turns to winter, he grows closer to two girls. Who misses whom? Who is falling in love? But the Mystery starts to affect them...
translation:
利兹出人意料地成为风暴的中心。他必须通过混乱和谎言找到真相。
秋去冬来，他和两个女孩的关系越来越近。谁想念谁？谁在坠入爱河？但神秘开始影响他们……
